description: This script generates a JSON description of the GN build environment for the ANGLE project, used to facilitate building Android.bp files for Android's Soong build system. It processes GN build targets, retrieves their dependencies recursively, and outputs a JSON file with build information.

methods.name: get_json_description
methods.description: Retrieves and parses the JSON description of a GN target, handling errors.

methods.name: load_json_deps
methods.description: Recursively loads dependencies of a target's JSON description.

methods.name: create_build_description
methods.description: Creates a JSON build description for specified targets by invoking GN.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Sets up argument parsing, initiates build description creation, and writes output file.
